author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
At the Academy's Margaret Herrick Library, Adam tours through the collection of movie scripts, news clippings, and publicity epherma that comprises just a fraction of the library's holdings documenting Hollywood film history. And in its collections vault, he encounters an eclectic sample of production materials from some of his favorite filmmakers. Plus, the original cowardly lion's wig from The Wizard of Oz!

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/ and https://www.academycollection.org/
Learn more about the Academy Library at https://www.oscars.org/library

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
